hypothesis: A shallow temporally stacked booster can use a legal row-local adaptive state probability as a fixed log-odds offset and learn only stable corrections from earlier outer-fold exact-C predictions. This should adapt the probability level to the target season without allowing a historical model to relearn a stale global intercept.

relationship_to_prior_work.dynamic_state_residual: That model regressed centered probability residuals around a fixed E14 state using same-fold raw labels. This model uses a fixed log-odds base margin, an adaptive pitcher state, and only prior outer-fold parent predictions for meta fitting.
relationship_to_prior_work.multinomial_offset: That model offset four reconstructed outcome probabilities and did not use honest outer-fold parent predictions. This model is a binary temporal stack whose fixed offset is the adaptive success state.
relationship_to_prior_work.adaptive_state_space: That experiment used a constant convex blend. This model learns a regularized nonlinear trust rule from strictly earlier outer folds.

fixed_recipe.route: R only; F remains the comparison baseline unchanged
fixed_recipe.state: V5_ADAPTIVE_STATE_SPACE_V1 probability computed independently from the current row official as-of counters and frozen pre-season train state
fixed_recipe.meta_training: For target year Y, concatenate only outer-fold predictions for 2020..Y-1; every parent value was generated by a model fitted strictly before its own fold.
fixed_recipe.correction_centering: Subtract the season-weighted mean in-sample tree correction on meta-training rows; no validation rows are used.

development.ranking: maximum minimum full-score gain across both years and all comparisons; then maximum minimum R gain; then smaller gamma
development.on_fail: Close this recipe without fitting or reading a 2024 candidate.
development.on_pass: Write an immutable confirmation lock before fitting 2024; no feature, model, gamma, or centering changes are permitted.
